text: This report provides information and identifies a preliminary set of issues regarding the Official Plan Amendment and Zoning By-law Amendment application for a 29-storey apartment building, containing 213 dwelling units. The application has been circulated to all appropriate City divisions and public agencies for comment. City Planning staff will proceed to schedule a Community Consultation Meeting for the application, in consultation with the Ward Councillor. Staff do not support this proposal in its current form. Substantial revisions are required to meet the policies of the Official Plan and Downtown Plan.

The Toronto and East York Community Council directed: 1. Staff schedule a community consultation meeting for the lands pertaining to 10 Huntley Street, together with the Ward Councillor as soon as possible in the new term of Council: a. If hosted in-person, includes the provision of light refreshments and, when required, childcare and accessibility resources including sign language interpretation at the sole cost of the applicant. b. If hosted virtually, includes the provision of accessibility resources including closed captioning and, upon request, sign language interpretation at the sole cost of the applicant. The meeting notice should clearly articulate who community members should contact to access these resources. 2.
